title: BHA (Butylated Hydroxyanisole): FDA Reassessment, Carcinogen Classification & State Bans
excerpt: BHA is under formal FDA post-market reassessment as of February 2026. Listed as a carcinogen by NTP and IARC. Banned in West Virginia (injunction pending). Complete compliance guide.
seo_title: BHA FDA Reassessment 2026: Carcinogen Status, West Virginia Ban & Compliance | Policy Canary
seo_description: BHA (butylated hydroxyanisole) regulatory status: FDA reassessment underway, NTP carcinogen listing, IARC Group 2B, West Virginia ban, Prop 65. Action steps for food companies.

structured_data.fda_status: GRAS (21 CFR 182.3169) and food additive (21 CFR 172.110) — under formal reassessment
carcinogen_classifications: NTP: Reasonably anticipated to be a human carcinogen (since 1991, reaffirmed 2021)
IARC: Group 2B — Possibly carcinogenic to humans (1987, Supplement 7)
state_bans: West Virginia (HB 2354, retail ban Jan 1, 2028 — preliminary injunction Dec 2025)

key_deadlines.label: FDA publishes Request for Information on BHA safety (91 FR 6227, Docket FDA-2026-N-0302)
FDA public comment deadline on BHA reassessment
West Virginia HB 2354 retail BHA ban effective (preliminary injunction pending)
